records.issue_text: app/models/topic_embed.rb:22 — Importing feed HTML through `raw_html` bypasses sanitization and preserves scripts and event handlers, allowing malicious JavaScript to execute in the forum’s origin; sanitize HTML before storing it as cooked content.
records.rationale: TopicEmbed.import passes remote/RSS-fetched contents to PostCreator with cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html], and Post#cook in the diff explicitly returns `raw` unfiltered for that cook method ('return raw if cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]'). The embed view then renders it with `<%= raw post.cooked %>`. No sanitization step appears anywhere in the diff, so script/event-handler HTML from an RSS feed or fetched remote page would be stored and rendered, enabling stored XSS in the forum origin.
